In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

if a single perspective image is available and a single weak (affine) image is available, then it is preferable to use the weak image for structure from motion rather than using the perspective image.
if a full perspective image is available, then it should be used, but if it is not, then the weak perspective approximation should be employed.
a weak perspective view is a good complement to a perspective view in the structure from motion task.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of full perspective and weak perspective images is more robust than the combination of two full perspective images.
a weak perspective image is more valuable than a perspective image for the structure from motion estimation.
the weak perspective approximation is more robust than a full perspective approximation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a combination of full perspective and weak perspective images can be used to obtain more stable results in the SFM process.

the weak perspective model can be useful for the estimation of the epipolar geometry from a pair of images, one of which is a close-up or a narrow FOV image, even if the images are not taken from a very large distance.
a weak perspective image can provide a significant improvement over a full perspective image in the context of SFM, even when the weak perspective image has a narrow field of view.
